name: stuck-offset
description: A server that ignores `offset` and replays the same non-empty page forever. Without a repeated-page guard the walk would re-import the identical page until the CONFIG maxPages backstop raised, doing a run's worth of useless requests first. The guard compares each page's length and first record to the previous page and stops with a log line before importing the replay, so the two devices come out exactly once. Skips namespaced_ids: netskope uses the bare nsdeviceuid as the foreign id, with no tenant scope; a documented, deliberate gap.

log_contains: netskope: server repeated the page at offset 2; stopping to avoid re-importing
